audit_items.proof_trace: The route handler `GET()` has no authentication or admin-role check — it only enforces a time-window guard (JST 22:50–23:50). The middleware at `src/middleware.ts` passes any request that carries `oauth_user_id` and `oauth_access_token` cookies (existence-only, no validity or role assertion), and `forceLogoutAll()` in `actions.ts:631` uses a service-role admin client with no caller verification. The property's `is_admin == true` precondition is absent from every layer of the call chain.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker who is a regular (non-admin) authenticated user obtains valid `oauth_user_id` and `oauth_access_token` session cookies, then sends `GET /api/admin/force-logout-all` during the 22:50–23:50 JST window; the service-role `forceLogoutAll()` executes and bulk-inserts `type: 'out'` attendance records for every currently checked-in user, corrupting all active attendance sessions.
